submission.body:
I independently inspected the repository for remaining `WorkOrderId` references after the contributors' passes.

Findings:
- One remaining source-code reference: `src/decision/commands.ts` still imported `WorkOrderId` from `../domain/primitives` and used it in the `start_work` command (line 15). This was an inconsistent stale reference because `TaskOrderId` was already defined in `primitives.ts` and used elsewhere in the same file.
- All other occurrences of `WorkOrderId` were in historical/documentation files (`CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/migration.md`) that intentionally describe the previous API.

Fix applied:
- Replaced the import in `src/decision/commands.ts` to import `TaskOrderId` instead of `WorkOrderId`.

Verification:
- `bun run typecheck` passes with no errors.
- `bun test` passes (86 tests, 0 fail).

The type rename from `WorkOrderId` to `TaskOrderId` is now complete throughout the repository's source and tests.
submission.title: Verify migration WorkOrderId → TaskOrderId
